label: Gift cards
description: The gift card band and its questions.

settings.question: How is a gift card sent?
settings.answer: By email, the same day, to you or straight to them, with a note if you like.

settings.question: What can a gift card buy?
settings.answer: Any treatment, class or product in the house, in any amount.

settings.question: Do gift cards expire?
settings.answer: No. A gift card keeps its value until it is spent, on any treatment or product.
